design_philosophy.core_emotion: I belong, I am growing, I have a mission. A spiritual arc from Encontro to Entrega.
design_philosophy.aesthetic: Modern, young, strong, spiritual, elegant, minimalist. Deep dark mode with fiery warm accents. Avoids childish visuals, excessive gold, and old institutional layouts.
anti_patterns: No pure black (#000000) backgrounds; use tinted warm darks.
No heavy drop shadows; rely on 1px borders and subtle glows.
No centered default text alignments; use intentional left-alignment for reading flow.

headings.usage: H1 to H4. Used for stage names, module titles, and main greetings.

spiritual_accent.usage: Exclusively for 'Palavra do Dia' (Word of the Day), biblical quotes, and spiritual reflections. Adds an elegant, grounded liturgical feel.

background.description: Deep void with a very subtle warm earthy tint. Evokes a night vigil.

brand_accent.description: The 'Fire/Holy Spirit' accent. Used for primary CTAs, active journey nodes, and progress bars. A void dark theme with this vivid fiery orange creates a strong, young, missionary feel without using gold.

status.usage: Used strictly for the Formador Pastoral Radar and 'Aguardando Avaliação' (Awaiting Approval) states.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a highly subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (`opacity-5` or `opacity-10` max) fixed to the background to remove digital flatness and make it feel like 'stone' or 'earth'.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Instead of gradients, use subtle radial glows behind active elements (e.g., `bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-orange-900/20 to-transparent`).
visual_enhancers.borders: Always use `border border-stone-800` on cards (`bg-stone-900`) to define edges against the `bg-stone-950` background.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the sticky bottom navigation and sticky headers: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-stone-950/80 border-t border-stone-800`.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first strictly. Design for 375px - 430px width primarily, scaling up to tablet/desktop.
responsive.layout: Vertical stacking. Use `flex-col` with generous gaps (`gap-6`, `gap-8`).
responsive.typography: Fluid or scalable text sizes. H1 at `text-3xl` on mobile, scaling to `text-5xl` on md+.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure `overflow-x-hidden` on main container to prevent horizontal scrolling on small screens.
responsive.tap_targets: All interactive elements must be minimum `min-h-[44px]` or `min-h-[48px]` for comfortable thumb tapping.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard: Mobile Bento Grid. 1 column layout. High priority to 'Palavra do Dia' (serif font) at the top, followed by 'Continue sua jornada' card, and upcoming events.
layouts_and_grids.journey_map: A vertical winding timeline. Nodes are staggered left and right (or straight vertical with an offset line on mobile). Nodes are connected by a vertical SVG line.
layouts_and_grids.formador_radar: List view with explicit color-coded badges (Green/Yellow/Red) representing the pastoral state of the youth.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use `p-6` or `p-8` inside major cards. `gap-6` between vertical sections.

bottom_navigation.style: Fixed at bottom `bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50`. Glassmorphism surface.

states.locked: Icon only, greyed out (`text-stone-600 bg-stone-900 border-stone-800`).
states.current: Pulsing amber glow, colored icon (`text-orange-500 border-orange-500 bg-orange-500/10 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,88,12,0.2)]`).

lesson_player.style: Clean video placeholder/container at top (aspect-video, rounded-xl), followed by tabbed content (Lesson info, Activities, Evaluation).

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or highly rounded (`rounded-xl`). Solid `bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white transition-colors duration-200`.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward translation (`translate-y-2` to `translate-y-0`) on enter.
motion.interactions: Scale down slightly on button active/press (`active:scale-95`).
motion.journey_progress: Animate the height/width of the connecting line between completed nodes.

worship_hero.description: Shallow focus photography of hands raised in worship, fits the 'youth, surrender' theme.

minimalist_cross.description: Minimalist illuminated cross against dark background. Elegant, not overly decorative.

community_fire.description: Youth sitting around a campfire at night. Symbolizes Encontro, Community, and Fire.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You MUST build a mobile-first interface. Assume viewport is mobile initially. Do not create wide desktop tables unless explicitly handling larger breakpoints.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create standard Shadcn components but override their styles to match the 'dark stone and fiery orange' aesthetic detailed in the colors section. Remove any default Vercal-like aesthetics.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the visual heavy elements like the Journey Map (vertical timeline). Do not force standard UI cards where a custom visual representation works better.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The 'Palavra do Dia' (Word of the Day) MUST use the `Cormorant Garamond` (or standard serif) font with italic styling to evoke a spiritual, grounded feeling.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use pure #000000. Use `bg-stone-950` as the absolute darkest background.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, navigation links, and major form inputs.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not add any fully transparent backgrounds to overlays/headers where text passes underneath. Always use `backdrop-blur` and a semi-transparent color like `bg-stone-950/80`.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: The app is in Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR). All UI text you generate must be in Portuguese.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Install fonts using standard Next/Google fonts or standard CSS `@import`. Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Cormorant Garamond.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-xl or rounded-full) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
